sources.title: Chegg Cuts 45% Of Employees After AI Slashes Traffic
sources.description: The study help firm is dropping 388 roles worldwide and bringing back Dan Rosensweig as chief executive, blaming falling referrals from Google.

sources.title: Chegg's CEO once said he's the 'poster child' for AI shock. Now, the company is slashing 45% of staff | Fortune
sources.description: The edtech pioneer is cutting 388 jobs and bringing back Dan Rosensweig as CEO, underscoring how generative AI and shrinking Google traffic are reshaping student learning.

sources.title: Chegg cuts 45% of staff as AI reshapes online learning business
sources.description: Chegg cuts 45% of workforce as AI disrupts online learning platform. Santa Clara company eliminates 388 jobs amid declining traffic and revenue challenges.

sources.title: Chegg to lay off 22% of workforce amid growing AI disruption
sources.description: The move comes as students increasingly rely on AI-driven tools such as ChatGPT instead of traditional edtech services

sources.title: Chegg Slashes 22% of Workforce Amid AI Disruption in EdTech
sources.description: Chegg announces layoffs of 22% of its workforce, attributing the move to declining demand due to the rise of AI-powered educational tools like ChatGPT.

sources.title: Chegg shutting down Israel operations, laying off entire workforce | CTech
sources.description: As part of a 23% cut in its global team, Chegg is closing its Israel office, resulting in the layoff of dozens of employees

sources.title: Why Chegg Stock Is Up Big Today | The Motley Fool
sources.description: The company is cutting costs as it looks to rework its offering

sources.title: Chegg Layoffs 2024: What to Know About the Latest Chegg Job Cuts
sources.description: Chegg layoffs have the company cutting hundreds of jobs and closing multiple offices as part of a larger restructuring.

sources.title: Edtech firm Chegg to cut 4% of staff as AI risks business
sources.description: San Francisco, June 14 (IANS) US-based online learning platform Chegg has revealed its plans to cut about 4 per cent of its workforce, just weeks after its CEO admitted that OpenAI's ChatGPT was crushing its business as more students are turning to artificial intelligence for homework assistance.
